The '''Elbaran sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the southwestern [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It bordered [[Gendius sector/Legends|Gendius]], [[Aldino sector/Legends|Aldino]], [[Almak sector/Legends|Almak]], [[Masla sector/Legends|Masla]], and [[Iska sector/Legends|Iska sectors]] in the Mid Rim.
